No application code is changed during initial evaluation.

summary.scope: Initial targeted probes plus manual full-output review. No universal or external-benchmark accuracy claim.

errors.explanation: The source includes /fil/ and the ambiguity is visible, but the material nylon is outside the current semantic class. The selected primary reading is wrong in this sentence.
errors.suggestion: Extend the explicit material semantic class for the construction fils de + material; retain ambiguity for unclassified complements rather than globally forcing fil after de.

errors.explanation: The first vowel is wrongly closed in the selected verbal family.
errors.suggestion: Review the occup- family including occuper and inflected forms together; preserve the corrected open vowel across morphology.

errors.explanation: A schwa-containing candidate is available but loses to an unlabelled /e/ variant.
errors.suggestion: Prefer attested schwa in the reviewed cheval/chevaux family and improve lexical ranking where stable consonant correspondence is shared but e-like vowel variants differ.

errors.explanation: Selected alternatives al/ɑl do not correspond to the requested traditional French hall; the required French reading has been lost from the compact alternatives.
errors.suggestion: Review hall/halls as an integrated loanword exception and audit candidate pruning when an independently attested French pronunciation is absent from the shortlist.

errors.explanation: The French contracted article has /dy/. The homograph /du/ exists in other languages and the source does not label languages.
errors.suggestion: Review closed-class French words comprehensively; do not allow unlabelled cross-language variants to override their grammatical readings.

errors.explanation: The reviewed entry itself uses the wrong vowel for feminine une, and presents it without ambiguity.
errors.suggestion: Correct the reviewed entry and review gendered article/pronoun paradigms together (un/une/unes, aucun/aucune) instead of extrapolating the masculine nasal vowel.

expertReview.contextualObservations: No incorrect realized liaison was found in the reviewed 25 outputs. All 24 pre-registered liaison probes pass, including punctuation, a nominal singular before a vowel, pronoun subject, adjective anteposition, h aspiré and obligatory possessive liaison. This small selection does not establish universal liaison accuracy.
expertReview.semanticUncertainty: The savant nominal/adjectival interpretation and plus comparative/negative meaning remain signaled; those warnings are appropriate. Wrong lexical /du/ and /ʃeval/ remain flagged as alternatives, while /œn/ and /okyp/ were incorrectly presented as lexical certainties.
expertReview.limitations: The expectations cover 56 targeted probes, not every phoneme of every sentence. Full outputs were reviewed manually for clear standard/traditional French errors. No numerical full-sentence accuracy is asserted. Cases selected by an implementer are only a small internal holdout, not a blind external benchmark. Reusing these cases for fixes makes later reruns regression checks, not independent validation.
